searches.note: Located actual indexed URLs for the Aiden Lab original supplemental PDF and published primary PDF. Supplemental index text identifies the assigned article and a Materials and Methods section headed Hi-C method. No filename was guessed.

Readable six-page PDF. The assigned article begins on PDF page 2, Science page 289, and ends on Science page 293. Figure 1 describes biotinylated junction isolation and paired-end sequencing. Its original SOM locator is www.sciencemag.org/cgi/content/full/326/5950/289/DC1; an earlier unrelated article's SOM locator also appears in the PDF and must not be confused with it.
The web tool reported content length too large: 23,684,326 bytes. Original bytes were not downloaded locally.

Indexed section Biotin pull-down and Paired End sequencing states that biotin-tagged Hi-C DNA is captured on streptavidin beads, paired-end adapters are ligated, and PCR uses bead-bound Hi-C library with Illumina PE1.0/PE2.0 primers. Subsequent large-scale PCR uses the remaining bead-bound library, followed by purification and sequencing. This is the precise substrate, priming and capture relationship requested for operation:o4, record, scope:Hi-C and unknown_hic_pcr_interface. Host acquisition, identity validation and provenance confirmation remain required; no graph acceptance is asserted.
No citation-bearing parent page exposing an actual hyperlink to either candidate was recovered from these provenance searches.
